exposure.needed: whether an issuer's linked Secret is updated at runtime, since that update event is what triggers the affected retry/back-off path

original.statement: In cert-manager 1.17.0 the issuer now retries more quickly when its linked Secret is updated, fixing an issue that previously caused a high back-off timeout.

decision.reason: [ev-10c8b1c28d66] only says the issuer now retries more quickly when its linked Secret is updated, which fixes a high back-off timeout. It names no field, Helm value, flag or issuer type, so no static setting determines exposure. Exposure depends on the runtime event of a linked Secret being updated. That makes undecidable with reason runtime-behavior-gap the right condition. P2's gvk-in-use Issuer would be too broad, and it would also miss ClusterIssuer.
